_readme: Add verbs to 'verbs'. persons: yo, tú, él/ella/usted, nosotros/as, vosotros/as, ellos/ellas/ustedes. Simple tenses stored; compound tenses built automatically by the app. 'irr' flags forms that differ from the regular pattern (highlighted). imperative: [tú, usted, nosotros, vosotros, ustedes].

examples.es: Hago la tarea por la noche.

examples.en: I go to work by bus.
We are going to eat now.
I could not sleep last night.

examples.es: Veo la televisión por la noche.

examples.en: I do not know the answer.
I found out the news yesterday.
I wanted to travel to Mexico.
I would like to book a table.
Are you coming to the party?
He came to see me yesterday.
I set the table every night.

examples.es: Puse las llaves en la mesa.
examples.en: I put the keys on the table.
Where have you put my book?

examples.es: Salgo de casa a las ocho.

examples.en: I will think about your offer.

examples.es: Llego al trabajo a las nueve.
examples.en: I arrive at work at nine.
We talked on the phone last night.
I will speak with him tomorrow.
I live in a small city.
He lived in Chile for two years.
We will live near the sea.

examples.es: Trabajó todo el fin de semana.

verbs.translation: to carry, to wear, to take

examples.en: I am wearing a blue jacket.

examples.es: Llevé a los niños al colegio.
examples.en: I took the children to school.

verbs.translation: to pass, to happen, to spend (time)

examples.es: Pasamos el verano en la playa.
examples.en: We spent the summer at the beach.
I drink coffee in the morning.
I am waiting for the train.

examples.es: Entro en la oficina a las nueve.
examples.en: I enter the office at nine.

verbs.translation: to stay, to arrange to meet, to be left

examples.es: Termino el trabajo a las seis.

examples.en: I buy fruit at the market.
I bought a gift for you.
I travel a lot for work.
He didn’t reply to my message.

verbs.translation: to lift, to raise (levantarse: to get up)

examples.en: I raise my hand in class.
I drink a lot of water.

verbs.translation: to go up, to raise, to upload

examples.es: Meto la ropa en la maleta.
examples.en: I put the clothes in the suitcase.

verbs.translation: to take out, to get (a grade)

examples.en: I take money out of the bank.
It cost a lot of money.

verbs.translation: to feel, to be sorry (sentirse: to feel)

examples.en: I grew up in the countryside.

verbs.translation: to beat, to defeat, to expire
to take, to grab, to catch

examples.en: I laugh a lot with them.
